title: Termwise products of K-injective complexes on a ringed space

from.place: proof, first step, derived-functor comparison after reconstructing the truncation tower

statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. If $(I_i^\bullet)_{i\in I}$ is a set-indexed family of K-injective complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pur-kinjective-complex], then the termwise product complex $\prod_i I_i^\bullet$ is K-injective and represents the product of the $I_i^\bullet$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].
